messages:
mike.g: Heads-up — sketching a canary ramp for model upgrade v2.1 -> want opinions on step sizes, soak windows, and SLO cutoff triggers before I put this into the API. TL;DR: multistep, faster initial ramp, longer soak near 50% and 90%.

anya: +1 on longer soak at midpoints. Can we make the initial steps smaller if latency-sensitive customers are present? e.g., 1%, 5%, 10% then 25/50/90.

samir: Agree. Also we need explicit telemetry checks per step: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token-loss/errors. Propose auto-hold if p95 > baseline + 15% OR 5xx rate > 0.5% absolute.

julia: From console UX POV: expose presets (fast, conservative, experimental) and advanced JSON editor. For presets, mapping could be: fast = [5, 25, 75], conservative = [1, 5, 25, 50, 90] with soak durations. Make each step editable inline.

elaine_pm: Would like A/B variant labeling for metrics ingestion so experiments and rollbacks are tracked separately. Also add a "customer-impact" score to the rollout metadata (low/medium/high) so SRE can prioritize.

mike.g: Drafting API shape below — open to tweaks. Key ideas: list of steps with percent, duration, optional guard expression, and escalation policy. Keep it small and explicit so UI can render easily.

mike.g: ```json
[
  {"pct": 1,   "dur": "10m", "guard": null},
  {"pct": 5,   "dur": "10m", "guard": {"p95_latency_pct": 115, "max_5xx_pct": 0.5}},
  {"pct": 10,  "dur": "15m", "guard": {"p95_latency_pct": 110, "max_5xx_pct": 0.4}},
  {"pct": 25,  "dur": "30m", "guard": {"p95_latency_pct": 110, "max_5xx_pct": 0.3}},
  {"pct": 50,  "dur": "60m", "guard": {"p95_latency_pct": 105, "max_5xx_pct": 0.2}},
  {"pct": 90,  "dur": "30m", "guard": {"p95_latency_pct": 105, "max_5xx_pct": 0.15}}
]
```

anya: The guard semantic needs to be clarified — are these absolute thresholds or relative to a baseline? Also what metric window do guards evaluate (last 5m, cumulative)?

samir: Baseline-relative for latency (pct of baseline p95), absolute for error %. Evaluate on rolling 5m window with 1m resolution and require the condition to hold for 2 consecutive windows before triggering hold/rollback. That avoids flapping.

julia: UI note — show a trend sparkline and a green/yellow/red microbadge per step; allow manual "force-advance" with justification. Also support an automatic rollback reason stub prefilled (e.g., "p95 spike > 15%") to link to incident.

elaine_pm: For A/B experiments: add labels like "variant=control|v2.1" and include experiment id. We need to ensure telemetry pipeline tags them so evaluation infra can compute conversion deltas without mixing traffic.

mike.g: Good points. Adding these refinements: guard semantics: latency = pct_of_baseline, errors = absolute; evaluation_window = 5m, required_consec = 2. Also adding an "escalation" field: notify on-call, page if rollback triggered, create incident draft.

mike.g: Updated snippet (inline):
```json
[
  {"pct": 1, "dur": "10m", "guard": null},
  {"pct": 5, "dur": "10m", "guard": {"p95_latency_ratio": 1.15, "max_5xx_pct": 0.005, "eval_window": "5m", "consec": 2}},
  {"pct": 10, "dur": "15m", "guard": {"p95_latency_ratio": 1.10, "max_5xx_pct": 0.004, "eval_window": "5m", "consec": 2}},
  {"pct": 25, "dur": "30m", "guard": {"p95_latency_ratio": 1.10, "max_5xx_pct": 0.003, "eval_window": "5m", "consec": 2}},
  {"pct": 50, "dur": "60m", "guard": {"p95_latency_ratio": 1.05, "max_5xx_pct": 0.002, "eval_window": "5m", "consec": 2}},
  {"pct": 90, "dur": "30m", "guard": {"p95_latency_ratio": 1.05, "max_5xx_pct": 0.0015, "eval_window": "5m", "consec": 2}}
]
```

samir: Okay. Also suggest a safety floor: if rollout is for customers with SLOs pinned to <100ms p50, add an override to bypass large jumps entirely for those customers by routing them to pinned model variant (opt-out lists).

anya: And add a rate-limit throttle so if traffic spike happens during step soak we auto-throttle ramp progression rather than advancing. Prevents accidental overrun.

mike.g: Noted. We should also add a "dry-run" mode for A/B experiments where traffic weights are mirrored for telemetry but responses still go to control (no customer impact). Helpful for quality checks.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary draft created: id=canary-2026-03-20-01. Use /canary review canary-2026-03-20-01 to open web UI.

julia: Final ask for UI: make guards visible in the timeline and exportable as JSON for audit. Also add a compact CSV export of step metrics for post-mortem.

mike.g: Thanks all. I'll post a PR with the API proto and console mocks later today. If no objections by EOD we'll roll to staging canary template. :thumbsup:
